entries.text: Napoleon "Neech" Manley. He was convicted in 1984 for double murder... In the holdup of a Florida liquor store. The actual gunman was killed in the pursuit. Manley was driving the getaway car and got sentenced to death.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: He was put to death in the electric chair three days ago.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: He'd been to the chair twice before, but the governor granted him last-minute stays.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: Third time's a charm. What's your interest in this?
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: Manley was interesting. He was well-read, charismatic. He became a writer, a kind of prison philosopher. A week before his execution, word went through the prison... That Neech said he was gonna be reincarnated. He was gonna come back from the dead.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: Well, reincarnation has always been popular on death row for obvious reasons.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: Apparently, this was more than just a dying man's hope against hope.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: What do you mean?
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: Manley didn't just claim that he was gonna come back, but that he was gonna take vengeance on five men who had mistreated him. Yesterday a death row guard was found dead inside the cell... That Manley had occupied those 11 years. His death cannot be explained.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: Has a cause of death been determined?
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: Suffocation, near as we can tell. Somebody must have snuffed him with a pillow.
entries.speaker: Warden Brodeur

entries.text: Any idea how one of your guards could get murdered... In an empty cell like this?
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: No. It's not supposed to happen, not with all the precautions we're taking.
entries.speaker: Warden Brodeur

entries.text: I see the guards here all wear panic devices. Was the victim's activated?
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: No. Apparently, he never touched it.
entries.speaker: Warden Brodeur

entries.text: According to our reports, there were threats this might happen.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: There's always threats of violence in here. Prison's nothing but a police state, basically.
entries.speaker: Warden Brodeur

entries.text: Do you give any credence to Neech Manley's claims... That he was gonna come back and take revenge?

entries.text: Neech Manley. Hmm. A smart man. Very smart man. In fact, if he'd stayed outside, I would have figured him for a nobel prize. But he made a mistake. Paid for it with his life. A man of that intelligence, you put him inside for 10 or 11 years, you're gonna have to pay for it.

entries.text: What do you mean?

entries.text: There's nothing but bitterness and resentment in here... 7 days a week, 24 hours a day, 365 days a year. It gets honed to a real fine point.
